automationIntent.reasoning: Upkeep registration exposes checkUpkeep/performUpkeep and the call history is dense and regular.

jobSemantics.description: Compounds accrued staking rewards back into the vault. Runs opportunistically whenever pending rewards exceed the gas cost of compounding.
jobSemantics.consequenceOfMissedAction: Rewards continue accruing and are compounded on the next run. A delayed compound costs a negligible amount of foregone yield; nothing is lost and no position is at risk.
